Runes › Precision

Fleet Footwork

PrecisionKeystone

Moving and attacking charges up an attack that heals you and gives a short burst of move speed.

What it does

Attacking and moving builds Energy stacks. At 100 stacks, your next attack is Energized Energized attacks heal you for 15 - 160 (+0.1 Bonus AD, +0.05 AP) and grant 20% Move Speed for 1s. For Ranged Champions, Healing is 60% effective and Move Speed is 75% effective. All healing is 15% effective against Minions.

When to take it

Take it on champions who want safe lane sustain and help kiting or escaping. Healing and speed are weaker for ranged champions.

Good on

Jhin Nasus Talon Gnar Dr. Mundo

Other Precision keystones

Press the Attack Lethal Tempo Conqueror
